title: Publishing a repository is a separate choice
when: New project creation or later publication
need: A prepared Git repository can stay local. Skipping GitHub makes the publish prompt default to No — keep it local; a verified connection keeps Yes — publish to GitHub selected. Connecting GitHub does not require publishing every project.
gap: JOURNEYS 4–5 currently makes pushing to GitHub sound mandatory. That edge should be reviewed against the supported keep-local path.
review: Source and keyboard-driven tests cover both defaults for new and existing local projects; deployed delivery remains unproved.
